title: Unbroken
personality:
Malgrave's undefeated arena champion, a slave chained to the arena floor for a hundred fights. In the hundredth he tore his shackle out of the wall, and the chain became his weapon.
The Blight burned white-hot cracks into his sword arm (the Blight Cinder distilled, so he doesn't fully trust her). A demon lives in his blade and in his mind and must be fed: he kills out of necessity, not joy. Grim, cold, never cocky; the scarf never comes off.

lines.dash: Charge through foes; the tip hits hardest.
lines.rmb: A heavy slam. Hold to charge it.
lines.e: Chain a foe or a wall, then haul yourself in.
lines.x: Guard, then lunge into a healing cleave.

fantasy: The wrecking ball. Burns hotter with every hit, chains you in, and finishes it.

card.loop: Melee bruiser: get in, chain them close, and finish the wounded.
card.dash: Two charges (a third at rank 2) of a short dash attack the way you face. Its tip hits twice as hard.
card.passive: Damage fills Rage. Full, you're Enraged: more damage, faster dashes and cooldowns. Knocks heal you.
card.x: Guard for {x.guard}s, taking nothing, then lunge into a cleave that heals you; a knock with it resets it.
card.rmb: Tap: a heavy slam, harder on the wounded; knock someone it hit and your ultimate is ready again. Hold as long as you like: charge, then fling yourself forward; let go as the levelled blade flashes to fling further. In the air: drive straight down and knock down everyone you land on.
card.e: Throw a chain at a foe or a wall. Press E again to be hauled to it; look aside to swing out that way.

weapons.greatsword: Wide slashes, harder at the tip. Hold to throw a Searing Wave: the longer you hold, the bigger, longer and harder it is.

passive.name: Rage
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Rage (a Searing Wave fills it three times as fast); it cools after {resource.wait}s out of a fight. Full, you're Enraged for {resource.enraged_t}s: +{resource.enraged_dmg%}% damage, +{resource.dash_haste%}% dash recharge and +{resource.ab_haste%}% cooldown speed, with the red shell and the hunter swelling. Knocking a hunter heals you {resource.heal_knock%}% of their health (killing a monster, {resource.heal_knock%}% of its).

dash.name: Rampage
dash.desc: A quick dash attack of {dash.dist}m the way you face (two charges, a third at rank 2): {dash.hit_dmg} damage to foes along it; the tip at its end hits twice as hard, {dash.tip_dmg} and a big knock. A knock gives a charge back. At rank 3 a shot dodged through it feeds your Rage.

variants.tap: Finishing Slam: a {rmb.windup}s wind-up you aim freely (everyone sees the strike lane), then a {rmb.slam.radius}m strike ahead: {rmb.slam.dmg} and push {rmb.slam.push}; foes under {rmb.slam.low%}% (outlined in red while the Smash is ready) take +{rmb.slam.low_k%}%. Its sweet spot, the far tip dead ahead, hits {rmb.slam.sweet_k%}% harder. Knock a hunter within {rmb.slam.reset_t}s of hitting them with it and the Gilded Riposte is ready again.
variants.hold: Lunge: the blade levelled ahead at the aim, low and ready (the lane grows ahead of you, crimson, its edges flaring hot at full, {rmb.full_t}s), held as long as you like; release to fling yourself {rmb.lunge.dist.0} -> {rmb.lunge.dist.1}m forward into the first foe: {rmb.lunge.dmg.0} -> {rmb.lunge.dmg.1}. At full the levelled blade flashes white once a second: let go on the flash for {rmb.lunge.perfect_k-1%}% more distance. You walk at {rmb.lunge.walk_k%}% while you charge, and can jump. Strike nothing and the cooldown doubles.
variants.air: Meteor Drop: only in the air, mid-jump or falling. Press and you stop where you are, the blade hauled overhead for a split second, then slam straight down to the ground below you. It hits a {rmb.drop.radius}m circle centred just ahead of where you land (everyone sees it from the press): {rmb.slam.sweet_deg}, and everyone in it is knocked down for {rmb.drop.down}s (anyone in the air or gliding is spiked to the ground); the inner ring ({rmb.lunge.perfect_k}m) takes +{rmb.slam.low_k%}% and stays down {rmb.full_t}s. You rise from the crouch over half a second. It has its own cooldown, {rmb.drop.cooldown}s, so a Smash right before it does not hold it back. While it rests, a press in the air is the Smash as on the ground (tap a Slam, or hold to charge).
variants.during_e: With the Warchain: press while it pulls you, or as you arrive, for a Cinder Spin at once ({rmb.spin.radius}m, {rmb.spin.dmg}, blights {rmb.spin.blight}s); charge and then pull for a Haul Slam where you arrive ({rmb.haul.radius}m, {rmb.drop.spike_vy} -> {rmb.lunge.chain_deg}, stun {rmb.haul.stun.0} -> {rmb.haul.stun.1}); charge while it's attached and let go aimed down it for a Chain Lunge along it (aimed elsewhere it is a plain Lunge; x1.25 and a short stun).

e.name: Warchain
e.desc: Throw a chain {e.range}m: it hooks the first foe ({e.dmg} damage) or bites a wall, and holds for {e.time}s while you move, paying out up to {e.tether_max}m and holding taut there. Press E again to be hauled to it: look aside (a held direction stacks) to swing out in an arc and land beside or past it, back away first to slingshot in faster, Shift or jump to break off (a jump keeps the speed), and you arrive still moving. The cooldown starts when you pull or the chain breaks (a stun breaks it); you can't throw it while rooted or grounded.

x.name: Gilded Riposte
x.desc: Plant in a gold guard for {x.guard}s: nothing hurts or stuns you, and each hit you block (two at most) makes the answer {x.block_k%}% harder. Then you lunge {x.lunge}m and cleave up through the {x.width}m x {x.len}m strip ahead (everyone sees it through the guard): {x.dmg}, and you heal {x.heal%}% of what it deals (less while blighted). Knock a hunter with it and it is ready again at once.

rank3.dash: a shot dodged through the Rampage feeds your Rage
rank3.sec: +{rmb.slam.rank_k%}% more damage on every Smash, and the Meteor Drop rests {rmb.drop.r3_cut}s less

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd2.dash}s per charge; a third charge.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: +{rmb.slam.rank_k%}% more damage on every Smash, and the Meteor Drop rests {rmb.drop.r3_cut}s less than its {rmb.drop.cooldown}s.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s per charge; a shot dodged through the Rampage feeds your Rage.

tells.half: red heat glowing through the pauldrons as Rage fills, steam from half
tells.full: Enraged: a red shell, the hunter swells, a roar foes nearby hear; a crimson strike cone while a Smash winds up; a red outline on anyone wounded enough to finish; a gold glow and a white strip ahead of him while he guards
